name: volt-azure-devops
description: Azure DevOps integration tools for Volt.

volt.description: Azure DevOps integration tools for Volt.

organization.title: Organization
organization.description: Azure DevOps organization (dev.azure.com/<organization>): letters, digits, and hyphens. VOLT_ADO_ORG and /ado-config for the session override it.

project.title: Project
project.description: Default project name or ID for tools that take a project.

authMode.title: Authentication
authMode.description: device-code signs in in a browser; pat reads VOLT_ADO_PAT or AZURE_DEVOPS_EXT_PAT; bearer reads VOLT_ADO_TOKEN. Unset: pat or bearer when its variable is set, else device-code.

tenantId.title: Tenant ID
tenantId.description: Azure tenant for device-code sign-in. Unset: the Azure SDK default.

clientId.title: App client ID
clientId.description: App registration (client ID, a GUID) for device-code sign-in. Unset: the Azure SDK default.
